summary: Civil dispute over land ownership vs criminal complaint for cheating; property described as CAPNIVORIL GUERA; FIR registered post-civil suits; ingredients of Section 415 IPC absent; purchaser not complaining; concealment not established; reliance on Mohd. Ibrahim case; quashing proper due to lack of criminal elements; civil ownership dispute cannot be converted to criminal case.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned FIR quashed; criminal proceedings terminated.
